title: Shopify promise and occasional hand delivery
text: I have a few customers who are local to me. Sometimes it makes more sense to arrange hand delivery, especially when I know them personally or want to establish a relationship. (One of them is the clerk at my FedEx store, lol.) Right now I just give them free shipping and drop it off. That kills my Shopify promise rating as there is no tracking information because I don’t buy a shipping label. I don’t want to offer pick-up or local delivery to everyone, but I’d like an honest evaluation of my Shopify promise where these don’t hurt me. I wish there was a way in ADMIN to mark something as local delivery completed so it removes it from the Shopify promise formula. 4 posts - 2 participants Read full topic
author: brassanchordesigns
triage_reason: Manual hand deliveries ruin automated Shopify promise shipping metrics.
